title: Community Vault
tagline: Community Vault, providing you the opportunity to deposit GHO and earn APY while unlocking exclusive NFT rewards
description:
Community Vault, providing you the opportunity to deposit GHO and earn APY while unlocking exclusive NFT rewards. 

Features:
- Deposit GHo to earn APY and unlock exclusive NFT rewards
- Loan NFTs to earn APY in GHo
- Deposits and contributions empower community members to vote on future proposals
- Actively participate in shaping the community's direction and future initiatives
how_its_made:
I developed the dApp using React and styled it with Chakra UI. The contract was built using Hardhat. I deployed my contracts on the Sepolia Testnet.

I used the following technologies:
Aave - Used GHO for a decentralized overcollateralized stablecoin 
Family - Used ConnectKit connecting a wallet to the dApp
